format_hint_rar5: Best compression and recovery record; opens with WinRAR 5+.
format_hint_rar_tool_required: Needs RARLAB's RAR tool; pressing Create shows how to get it.
format_hint_7z: Free, high compression; supports AES-256 passwords and name encryption.
format_hint_zip: Most common format; passwords use AES-256 (older extractors may not support it).
format_hint_tar_compressed: For Unix/Linux; no password or volume support.
compress_exists_message: Create a new archive, or add the files to the existing one?
compress_exists_encrypted_message: An archive with this name already exists and is encrypted. Create a new unencrypted archive, or add the files to the encrypted archive?
compress_exists_no_append_message: Files cannot be added to an existing archive of this format. Create a new archive?
compress_exists_split_message: A split archive with this name already exists, and files cannot be added to one. Create a new archive?
compress_invalid_volume_size: “%@” is not a valid split size. Use a number with an optional K, M or G, such as 100M.
zip_password_not_ascii: A ZIP password can hold only English letters, digits, spaces and symbols. If the password has letters such as ü or ş, choose 7z or RAR. You can also change the password.
zip_password_too_long: A ZIP password can be at most 99 characters long. Shorten the password, or choose 7z or RAR.
rar_password_emoji_counted_twice: RAR uses only the first 127 characters of a password, while 7-Zip counts an emoji as two characters. This password has an emoji among its first 127 characters, so 7-Zip, and MacRAR with it, could not open the archive. Shorten the password or remove the emoji.
add_tar_compressed_unsupported: Files cannot be added to tar.gz / tar.xz archives. Create a new archive instead.
delete_tar_compressed_unsupported: Entries cannot be deleted from tar.gz / tar.xz archives.

rar_tool_required_message:
Creating or modifying RAR archives needs RARLAB's “RAR for macOS” tool (paid, 40-day trial). Its licence does not allow bundling it with this app.

1. On the download page, get “RAR for macOS ARM” (Apple Silicon) or “RAR for macOS x64” (Intel).
2. Use “Choose Downloaded File…” to point to it.

Opening RAR archives and working with ZIP, 7z and TAR does not need it.

rar_tool_err_not_rarlab: That “rar” is not RARLAB's RAR for macOS. Choose the “RAR for macOS” download from rarlab.com.
rar_tool_err_wrong_arch: The RAR tool did not run on this Mac. Make sure you downloaded the right build (ARM for Apple Silicon, x64 for Intel).
